description: Open an additional, independent browser session (its own window, cookies, and login state) and make it the active one; all other tools act on the active session. Use it to test several users at once, such as a buyer and a seller, or to compare two states side by side. Switch between sessions with session_select. Takes the same options as start_browser. Returns the new session and overall status.

browser.description: Which browser to launch: chrome (default), firefox, or edge. It must be installed on this machine.

browserArgs.description: Extra command-line flags for the browser, e.g. ['--incognito']. Default none.

headless.description: Run without a visible window (default false).

pageLoadTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time a page load may take before navigate fails, in milliseconds (default 30000).

scriptTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time an asynchronous script may run, in milliseconds (default 30000).

sessionId.description: Optional readable id for the session, e.g. 'buyer' or 'admin' (1-128 chars). Defaults to a random UUID.

windowSize.description: Initial window size, e.g. { width: 1440, height: 900 }. Change it later with the window tool's resize action.

name: session_create
